page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is an x86_64 architecture instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core. The instance features 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.m2.medium offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The absence of hyper-threading ensures predictable single-threaded core performance. This profile is suitable for hosting medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound backend services.
